Entries.Title: Jurassic World Rebirth
Entries.Description: Five years after the events of Jurassic World Dominion, covert operations expert Zora Bennett is contracted to lead a skilled team on a top-secret mission to secure genetic material from the world's three most massive dinosaurs. When Zora's operation intersects with a civilian family whose boating expedition was capsized, they all find themselves stranded on an island where they come face-to-face with a sinister, shocking discovery that's been hidden from the world for decades.

Entries.Title: Night Carnage
Entries.Description: A blogger who is also a werewolf meets a dashing playboy with a dark secret of his own. Starring Logan Andrews and Christian Howard.

Entries.Title: How to Train Your Dragon
Entries.Description: On the rugged isle of Berk, where Vikings and dragons have been bitter enemies for generations, Hiccup stands apart, defying centuries of tradition when he befriends Toothless, a feared Night Fury dragon. Their unlikely bond reveals the true nature of dragons, challenging the very foundations of Viking society.

Entries.Title: Creation of the Gods II: Demon Force
Entries.Description: Taishi Wen Zhong led the army of Shang Dynasty including Deng Chanyu and four generals of the Mo Family to Xiqi. With the help of Kunlun immortals such as Jiang Ziya, Ji Fa led the army and civilians of Xiqi to defend their homeland.

Entries.Title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle
Entries.Description: As the Demon Slayer Corps members and Hashira engaged in a group strength training program, the Hashira Training, in preparation for the forthcoming battle against the demons, Muzan Kibutsuji appears at the Ubuyashiki Mansion. With the head of the Demon Corps in danger, Tanjiro and the Hashira rush to the headquarters but are plunged into a deep descent to a mysterious space by the hands of Muzan Kibutsuji.  The destination of where Tanjiro and Demon Slayer Corps have fallen is the demons' stronghold – the Infinity Castle. And so, the battleground is set as the final battle between the Demon Slayer Corps and the demons ignites.

Entries.Title: Ne Zha 2
Entries.Description: After a catastrophic event leaves their bodies destroyed, Ne Zha and Ao Bing are granted a fragile second chance at life. As tensions rise between the dragon clans and celestial forces, the two must undergo a series of perilous trials that will test their bond, challenge their identities, and decide the fate of both mortals and immortals.

Entries.Title: M3GAN 2.0
Entries.Description: After the underlying tech for M3GAN is stolen and misused by a powerful defense contractor to create a military-grade weapon known as Amelia, M3GAN's creator Gemma realizes that the only option is to resurrect M3GAN and give her a few upgrades, making her faster, stronger, and more lethal.

Entries.Title: The Pickup
Entries.Description: A routine cash pickup takes a wild turn when mismatched armored truck drivers Russell and Travis are ambushed by ruthless criminals led by savvy mastermind Zoe.

Entries.Title: Guns Up
Entries.Description: When a job goes horribly wrong, an ex-cop and family man who moonlights as a mob henchman has one night to get his family out of the city.

Entries.Title: Superman
Entries.Description: Superman, a journalist in Metropolis, embarks on a journey to reconcile his Kryptonian heritage with his human upbringing as Clark Kent.

Entries.Title: Ice Road: Vengeance
Entries.Description: Big rig ice road driver Mike McCann travels to Nepal to scatter his late brother’s ashes on Mt. Everest. While on a packed tour bus traversing the deadly 12,000 ft. terrain of the infamous Road to the Sky, McCann and his mountain guide encounter a group of mercenaries and must fight to save themselves, the busload of innocent travelers, and the local villagers’ homeland.

Entries.Title: Karate Kid: Legends
Entries.Description: After a family tragedy, kung fu prodigy Li Fong is uprooted from his home in Beijing and forced to move to New York City with his mother. When a new friend needs his help, Li enters a karate competition – but his skills alone aren't enough. Li's kung fu teacher Mr. Han enlists original Karate Kid Daniel LaRusso for help, and Li learns a new way to fight, merging their two styles into one for the ultimate martial arts showdown.

Entries.Title: Ballerina
Entries.Description: Taking place during the events of John Wick: Chapter 3 – Parabellum, Eve Macarro begins her training in the assassin traditions of the Ruska Roma.

Entries.Title: Bride Hard
Entries.Description: Sam is a secret agent whose toughest mission to date is pleasing her bride-to-be best friend at a lavish destination wedding. When a team of mercenaries crashes the party and takes the guests hostage, Sam is thrown into a fight unlike any before — one where she can’t risk blowing her cover or ruining the big day. As she takes on the bad guys in a high-stakes battle disguised as a fairy-tale affair, she realizes the real threat might be closer than she thinks.

Entries.Title: Man with No Past
Entries.Description: Waking up in an unfamiliar city, a man with no memory must confront the mysteries of his own identity. However, his desperate search to uncover the past pits him against a powerful enemy, leading to a showdown that ultimately reveals the truth.

Entries.Title: Thunderbolts*
Entries.Description: After finding themselves ensnared in a death trap, seven disillusioned castoffs must embark on a dangerous mission that will force them to confront the darkest corners of their pasts.

Entries.Title: Almost Cops
Entries.Description: When an overeager community officer and a reckless ex-detective are forced to team up, plenty of chaos ensues on the streets of Rotterdam.

Entries.Title: F1
Entries.Description: Racing legend Sonny Hayes is coaxed out of retirement to lead a struggling Formula 1 team—and mentor a young hotshot driver—while chasing one more chance at glory.

Entries.Title: Mission: Impossible - The Final Reckoning
Entries.Description: Ethan Hunt and team continue their search for the terrifying AI known as the Entity — which has infiltrated intelligence networks all over the globe — with the world's governments and a mysterious ghost from Hunt's past on their trail. Joined by new allies and armed with the means to shut the Entity down for good, Hunt is in a race against time to prevent the world as we know it from changing forever.

Entries.Title: The Naked Gun
Entries.Description: Only one man has the particular set of skills... to lead Police Squad and save the world: Lt. Frank Drebin Jr.

Entries.Title: Lilo & Stitch
Entries.Description: The wildly funny and touching story of a lonely Hawaiian girl and the fugitive alien who helps to mend her broken family.

Entries.Title: The Fantastic 4: First Steps
Entries.Description: Against the vibrant backdrop of a 1960s-inspired, retro-futuristic world, Marvel's First Family is forced to balance their roles as heroes with the strength of their family bond, while defending Earth from a ravenous space god called Galactus and his enigmatic Herald, Silver Surfer.

Entries.Title: The Bad Guys 2
Entries.Description: The now-reformed Bad Guys are trying (very, very hard) to be good, but instead find themselves hijacked into a high-stakes, globe-trotting heist, masterminded by a new team of criminals they never saw coming: The Bad Girls.

Entries.Title: A Minecraft Movie
Entries.Description: Four misfits find themselves struggling with ordinary problems when they are suddenly pulled through a mysterious portal into the Overworld: a bizarre, cubic wonderland that thrives on imagination. To get back home, they'll have to master this world while embarking on a magical quest with an unexpected, expert crafter, Steve.

Entries.Title: Dora and the Search for Sol Dorado
Entries.Description: Dora, Diego, and their new friends trek through the perilous dangers of the Amazonian jungle in search of the ancient and powerful treasure of Sol Dorado to keep it out of enemy hands.

Entries.Title: Zombies 4 - Dawn of the Vampires
Entries.Description: A new adventure dawns for Zed and Addison when their summer road trip takes an unexpected detour, landing them in the middle of yet another monster rivalry: Daywalkers vs. Vampires. Tensions flare when Zed and Addison find themselves acting as camp counselors between the two opposing supernatural factions. With the help of Eliza and Willa, they must convince sworn enemies Nova and Victor to try to unite their warring worlds before an even greater threat endangers them all.

Entries.Title: Kayara
Entries.Description: A courageous and athletic teenager, Kayara dreams that she is destined to be the first female to break into the league of Chasquis - the official messengers of the Incan empire. As she learns what it takes to be a Chasqui along with its challenges, she tackles every mission she gets and discovers the ancient stories of her land and her people.

Entries.Title: Sneaks
Entries.Description: Ty, a misguided, one-of-a-kind designer sneaker, doesn’t know life outside the comforts of his velvet-lined shoebox. After his sister is stolen by a shady collector, Ty must venture into New York City to find and rescue her. In his adventure, Ty meets a ragtag group of footwear friends from all walks of life who help him find the courage to step outside of his shoebox and find his sole-mate.

Entries.Title: Mikaela
Entries.Description: During the eve of the 6th of January, a record-breaking snowstorm sweeps across Spain. In the midst of its chaos, a group of robbers seizes the opportunity to hijack an armoured van. A few meters away is Leo, a finished policeman who has nothing to lose. With the unexpected aid of a young woman, he will try to stop the band from running away with their loot.

Entries.Title: In the Lost Lands
Entries.Description: A queen sends the powerful and feared sorceress Gray Alys to the ghostly wilderness of the Lost Lands in search of a magical power, where she and her guide, the drifter Boyce, must outwit and outfight both man and demon.

Entries.Title: Elio
Entries.Description: Elio, a space fanatic with an active imagination, finds himself on a cosmic misadventure where he must form new bonds with eccentric alien lifeforms, navigate a crisis of intergalactic proportions and somehow discover who he is truly meant to be.

Entries.Title: K.O.
Entries.Description: A former fighter must find the missing son of an opponent he accidentally killed years ago, taking on a brutally violent crime gang in Marseille.

Entries.Title: Avatar: Fire and Ash
Entries.Description: In the wake of the devastating war against the RDA and the loss of their eldest son, Jake Sully and Neytiri face a new threat on Pandora: the Ash People, a violent and power-hungry Na'vi tribe led by the ruthless Varang. Jake's family must fight for their survival and the future of Pandora in a conflict that pushes them to their emotional and physical limits.

Entries.Title: Chief of War
Entries.Description: With Hawaii's four kingdoms divided by war, the ferocious warrior Kaʻiana embarks on an epic mission to unite his people—as an existential threat approaches their shores.

Episodes.Title: The Chief of War
Episodes.Description: Kaʻiana is summoned back home to Maui where he must decide whether to join King Kahekili in war.

Episodes.Title: Changing Tides
Episodes.Description: Fearing for their lives, Kaʻiana and his family flee O‘ahu. An ally emerges with a promise of safe passage.

Episodes.Title: City of Flowers
Episodes.Description: Kaʻiana arrives in a strange land. Kaʻahumanu takes her place beside Kamehameha.

Episodes.Title: Ciudad De Flores (2)
Episodes.Description: A dangerous power struggle emerges in the Kingdom of Hawai'i. Kamehameha wrestles with his new responsibility. Kaʻiana searches for Tony.

Entries.Title: Nukitashi the Animation
Entries.Description: On Seiran Island, secret society NLNS is united by Junnosuke Tachibana, who is determined to crush a law. They have found a benefactor, an unknown rich man, who offers them a secret base and cash. Their mission is to locate a mysterious girl and stop the law, keeping the SHO off their trail.

Episodes.Title: Pervert Law
Episodes.Description: Seiran Island, the land of paradise, aka the land of filthy debauchery, where any sexual acts are permitted and enforced by the Pervert Law. Junnosuke, a transfer, is a virgin with pride who despises sex with no love. However, sex is a duty of the island residents! Virginity is a serious crime!! All those who refuse sex will get guillotined by the Future Seiran Homeland Organization (or FS)!!! Junnosuke decides to protect his virginity with his dear life, evading all perverts along with his young virgin sister, Asane. However, they run into Nanase Katagiri, the school's legendary virgin hunter #$%!*...!

Episodes.Title: Savior
Episodes.Description: Item creation to outsmart the FS, securing every escape route, and Nanase's home cooking that achieves perfect nutrition. With Nanase as their ally, Junnosuke and Masane begin their plan to destroy the perverted ordinance. And on Seiran Island, there were other girls besides them who were also struggling! Hinami Watarai, a virgin who is never propositioned for sex by anyone due to her youthful appearance! Azumi Misaki, a virgin with a terrifying libido, but who doesn't want to show her plump body to others! One day, a major incident befalls Hinami!?

Entries.Title: Chespirito: Not Really on Purpose
Entries.Description: Miniseries that follow the life and career of Mexican actor, comedian and producer Roberto Gómez Bolaños, known for being the creator of El Chavo del 8, El Chapulín Colorado and Chespirito.

Episodes.Title: Cobbler, Stick to Thy Last
Episodes.Description: In 1951, Roberto pursues his dream of a career in television, defying his mother's orders, to try his hand at both comedy...and love.

Episodes.Title: Every Cloud Has a Silver Lining
Episodes.Description: Now known as Chespirito, Roberto decides to try his luck on another channel and, despite some setbacks, manages to put together a successful sketch.

Episodes.Title: Don't Get 'Reathers Fluffled!
Episodes.Description: Doctor Chapatín's resignation puts Roberto's career at risk, so he must create a new character before the executives give his place to another comedian. But it's his cunning and an old idea that will save the day.

Episodes.Title: It's Just That You Have No Patience for Me
Episodes.Description: In 1936, a young Roberto is sent to Guadalajara, where he struggles to fit in. Decades later, the now seasoned Chespirito finds himself lost without his biggest supporters at Channel 8, but memories of childhood help the comic conceive El Chavo del Ocho -- his most successful series yet.

Episodes.Title: He Who Laughs Last…
Episodes.Description: As El Chavo gains popularity and Roberto is given more creative freedom, Channel 8's competitors vie to bring Chespirito on board. Meanwhile, success and fame cause trouble for Roberto, his team and his family, leading to the comic's most prolific -- and devastating -- era.

Episodes.Title: The Price of Fame
Episodes.Description: With Roberto's career on the rise, the cast of El Chavo embarks on an international tour. But while her husband dives headfirst into his work, Graciela struggles with her new reality as the wife of a star.

Episodes.Title: On the Fence
Episodes.Description: As Chespirito's characters reach the height of their popularity across Latin America, Roberto relishes in his newfound level of fame -- while growing more distant from his family back home. In Acapulco, Roberto finds himself struggling with what he feels and what he thinks is right.

Episodes.Title: It Was Worth It
Episodes.Description: Roberto gets his team together for one last project -- a comedic soccer film called El Chanfle. While the cast and crew come to blows on set, Roberto faces a choice between his past and his future. Later, a warm welcome in Colombia reminds Chespirito of his true purpose: making people laugh.

Entries.Title: Eyes of Wakanda
Entries.Description: Follow the adventures of brave Wakandan warriors throughout history in this globe-trotting adventure, where they must carry out dangerous missions to retrieve Vibranium artifacts from the enemies of Wakanda. They are the Hatut Zaraze and this is their story.

Episodes.Title: Into the Lion's Den
Episodes.Description: A former member of the Dora Milaje is sent to take down a rogue Wakandan known as The Lion.

Episodes.Title: Legends and Lies
Episodes.Description: Amidst the Trojan War, a soldier attempts to breach the city's defenses to retrieve an artifact.

Episodes.Title: Lost and Found
Episodes.Description: A powerful stowaway infiltrates the Golden City and threatens the secrets kept within.

Episodes.Title: The Last Panther
Episodes.Description: Two Wakandans must choose to complete their mission or defy their homeland and save their world.

Entries.Title: SAKAMOTO DAYS
Entries.Description: Once the greatest hitman of all, Taro Sakamoto retired in the name of love. But when his past catches up, he must fight to protect his beloved family.

Episodes.Title: The Legendary Hit Man
Episodes.Description: Sakamoto enjoys a quiet life in retirement with his family. But one day, an old colleague demands he return to the assassin world — or face consequences.

Episodes.Title: Vs. Son Hee and Bacho
Episodes.Description: While out on an errand, Sakamoto and Shin encounter Lu Shaotang, the daughter of a mafia boss, who's on the run and targeted by twin assassins.

Episodes.Title: Welcome to Sugar Park
Episodes.Description: After learning of the huge bounty on Sakamoto's head, the crew tries to enjoy a family outing at the amusement park while fending off assassins.

Episodes.Title: Hard-Boiled
Episodes.Description: With the poison-wielding hitman taken out, the Sakamotos head to their next attraction, where they're ambushed by Dondenkai Ltd's ultimate assassin duo.

Episodes.Title: Source of Strength
Episodes.Description: Sakamoto goes all out in a fierce one-on-one duel with Boiled. Meanwhile, ORDER members are tasked with handling a serial case targeting assassins.

Episodes.Title: Heisuke Mashimo
Episodes.Description: Hoping to win the million-yen prize, Team Sakamoto enters the shopping district's survival tournament and teams up with a completely clueless sniper.

Episodes.Title: Jurassic Bastard
Episodes.Description: While manning the store alone, Lu gets kidnapped by a mysterious group. Sakamoto and Shin pursue her but are halted by an invisible assassin.

Episodes.Title: Sakamoto's vs. the Lab
Episodes.Description: To rescue Lu, Sakamoto and Shin infiltrate a top-secret lab seized by assassins. Meanwhile, in the prison cell, Lu meets someone from Shin's childhood.

Episodes.Title: All Aboard
Episodes.Description: In the depths of the Lab, Shin and Heisuke join forces to take down the invisible assailant, while Sakamoto engages in an intense battle against Kashima.

Episodes.Title: Bathhouse Roughhouse
Episodes.Description: Exhausted from their battle, the crew heads to a local bathhouse but finds it too dangerous to relax. Later, a mysterious man arrives in search of Lu.

Episodes.Title: Casino Battle
Episodes.Description: The crew faces Wutang in a high-stakes casino showdown to learn who issued Sakamoto's bounty. Meanwhile, X sends a group of vicious assassins their way

Episodes.Title: Overload
Episodes.Description: As Sakamoto gathers intel on the assassins targeting him, ORDER begins hunting the death row inmates. Later, Shin and Lu face a deadly assault.

Episodes.Title: Just Desserts
Episodes.Description: Saw's attacks push Shin and Lu to awaken new abilities, turning the tables on the deadly killer. Meanwhile, Dump ambushes Osaragi at a temple.

Episodes.Title: Strong Assault
Episodes.Description: The battles rage on even as the crew gets treated by Granny Miya! Minimalist threatens Aoi at the store while Heisuke clashes with Apart at Tokyo Tower.

Episodes.Title: Round and Round the Tower
Episodes.Description: Deadly battles with death row inmates break out everywhere! The Minimalist who attacked the Sakamoto Store is defeated by Nagumo of ORDER, disguised as Aoi, leaving only Apart as the only death row inmate remaining.

Entries.Title: Gachiakuta
Entries.Description: In a floating city where the rich discard their waste—and people—Rudo is framed for murder and thrown into the Pit, where a hellscape of mutated garbage beasts dwell. To survive, he must wield a new power and join the rogue Cleaners. Rudo doesn’t just aim to battle monsters, but the corrupt who cast him into Hell.

Episodes.Title: The Sphere
Episodes.Description: Bullied outcast Rudo finds respite in repurposing trash, until a terrible tragedy changes his life forever.

Episodes.Title: The Inhabited
Episodes.Description: Cast into the Pit, Rudo is saved by the mysterious Enjin who may not have his best interests at heart.

Episodes.Title: The Ground
Episodes.Description: Enjin is a Giver, a being who can give life to things and draw out their power. Ludo, who has also awakened to his power as a Giver, is scouted by Enjin to join an organization called the Cleaners, which fights against the Spotted Beasts born from garbage. Ludo accepts the offer in order to find a way to return to the Heavenly World where he has lived until now, but he suddenly gets into a fight with his trainer, Zanca.

Episodes.Title: Cleaner HQ
Episodes.Description: After being introduced to Cleaner HQ, Rudo follows Riyo on a job to learn the business.

Episodes.Description: Yoshiki confronts Hikaru about his suspicions and discovers the terrifying truth. Even though they try to live normally, eerie incidents begin to occur.

Episodes.Description: While Yoshiki and Hikaru accompany their classmates to a creepy mountain trail, a mysterious man arrives at Kubitachi Village and begins investigating.

Entries.Description: When the intimidating Rintaro meets the open-minded Kaoruko, the unlikely duo grows closer. The issue? Their neighboring high schools hate each other.

Episodes.Title: Chidori and Kikyo

Entries.Title: The Wonderfully Weird World of Gumball
Entries.Description: Welcome back to Elmore, where the laws of reality are a joke, and family life is anything but ordinary. Whether he's battling an evil fast-food empire, facing off against a sentient AI in love with his mom, or trying to stop Banana Joe from wearing pants — Gumball Watterson drags his brother Darwin, sister Anais, and the rest of the town of Elmore along for the ride. With even wilder stories, bigger twists, and surreal humor, the show is so amazing that they had to rename it!

Episodes.Title: The Burger
Episodes.Description: Gumball and Darwin want to find a healthy dinner option for their family because they are hooked on Joyful Burger, but an evil food consortium has monopolized the food industry.

Episodes.Title: The Assistant
Episodes.Description: Feeling unappreciated by her family, Nicole strikes up a friendship with a sympathetic Al. As their relationship intensifies, the Al tries to drive a wedge between Nicole and the other Wattersons.

Episodes.Title: The Distance
Episodes.Description: Gumball must find a way to save his relationship with Darwin after the boys are forced to live in separate rooms.

Episodes.Title: The Thing
Episodes.Description: Richard must retrace the memories of his day in order to figure out what "the thing" is, so Nicole's family dinner with Granny Jo Jo won't be another epic failure.

Episodes.Title: The Butts
Episodes.Description: Gumball must help Principal Brown have body confidence about his butt in order to be allowed to do his poem about butts at the Poetry Recital.

Episodes.Title: The Traffic
Episodes.Description: The Wattersons must get Anais to Daisyland before the park closes for good.

Entries.Description: Student council president Takane Takamine is a popular star student. On the other hand, Koushi Shirota doesn't have many friends. That all changes when Koushi accidentally discovers Takane's ability to go back in time and alter past actions just by changing her lingerie. After some pestering, Koushi agrees to help Takane and be her closet, by having spare lingerie on hand.

Episodes.Title: Become My Closet
Episodes.Description: Takamine is basically a goddess. Shirota is like an NPC, but he glimpses her bare breasts. Weirdness ensues...

Episodes.Title: Let Me Redo It Until I'm Satisfied.
Episodes.Description: It's Shirota's first day as Takamine's closet. How is he even supposed to pull off what she's asking of him?

Episodes.Title: Don't Be Dense, Be Sharp.
Episodes.Description: When Shirota gets sick, Takamine nurses him with surprising devotion, making him wonder if it means something.

Episodes.Title: I Want You to Make This Cat Purr, Meow.
Episodes.Description: Shirota is over at Takamine's place, but then the lightning knocks out the power and sends her into his arms.

Episodes.Title: Honey, Let Me Wash Your Back.
Episodes.Description: Takamine and Shirota roleplay newly-weds. She escalates things by joining him in the bath to wash his back.

Episodes.Title: Even That Which Isn't Visible From There
Episodes.Description: Takamine and Shirota talk about the future. When he says he's set on work, not college, she briefly looks sad.

Episodes.Title: You Two Seem Quite Intimate
Episodes.Description: Shirota runs into Ellie, a friend from grade school. They're hanging out in the park where Takamine sees them.

Episodes.Title: Let Me Do It!!
Episodes.Description: Takamine challenges Shirota to a water balloon fight, the loser has to obey the winner. What will it be?

Episodes.Title: It Rains, and Shirota Freezes Up
Episodes.Description: The class will put on the play Cinderella. Naturally, Takamine will be Cinderella, but who will be the prince?

Episodes.Title: I'll Let You Do a Dry Run
Episodes.Description: To calm Shirota's nerves, Takamine goes into the haunted house with him. It works, but now where is Ouji?

Episodes.Title: Only Look At Me
Episodes.Description: Can Shirota make it to the end of Cinderella without messing up? Near the end, something unexpected happens!

Entries.Title: The Share House's Secret Rule
Entries.Description: After entering university, Ryota moves into a share house where he meets two stunningly beautiful sharemates, Momoka and Kanade. As the three of them begin to cohabitate together, they agree on one "secret rule." "If it's just for a minute, you can touch whatever you want." Thus begins Ryota's new life at the share house, where sweet temptation lies behind every door...!

Episodes.Title: My roommates are way too cute
Episodes.Description: After Ryota moves into a share house, he finds himself living with two gorgeous housemates. At first, it seems like a dream come true, but he soon discovers that the two girls are incredibly lazy! Ryota’s patience quickly runs out, and decides to leave. But before he can go, the two make him an intriguing offer: “How about a new rule? For every chore you do, you get to touch us for one minute…”

Episodes.Title: Come on... Touch me
Episodes.Description: Taking advantage of the "Touch Points" system his roommates suggested, Ryota and Momoka begin to get a bit closer. But after things go a little too far, the atmosphere between them turns awkward. Has Kanade noticed what’s going on? Either way, she doesn’t hold back—leaning in as Ryota massages her shoulders, she whispers, “Come on... touch me. For one minute, you can do whatever you want…”

Episodes.Title: I’ll do it for you...
Episodes.Description: Ryota uses his "Touch Points" with Kanade, and before he knows it, the two of them start getting hot and heavy... Given the recent developments, Ryota feels the dynamic with his two beautiful roommates shifting. Just then, Momoka decides it’s time to join in on the housework, declaring, “I have points from housework too... Now I'll do it for you…”

Episodes.Title: I'm just working out...!
Episodes.Description: After things heat up between Momoka and Ryota, she starts to feel embarrassed and begins avoiding him around the house. Ryota then hears a loud noise at the entrance—it’s Kanade, stumbling in, clearly drunk! With no other choice, Ryota helps her to her room. But as they reach her bed, Kanade, still tipsy, looks up at him and pleads, “Hey… you’ve still got some Touch Points left, right?”

Episodes.Title: They might hear me...
Episodes.Description: After learning that Momoka is being followed by a male student from her university, Ryota steps in to help by posing as her boyfriend to keep the stalker at bay. Though the plan succeeds, the stalker lashes out, and Ryota ends up injured while protecting her. Later, as Momoka cares for him in the hospital, the two find themselves closer than they’ve been in a long time.

Episodes.Title: You've had too much to drink...
Episodes.Description: After the restaurant that Kanade works at becomes short-staffed, she desperately asks Ryota for help. To his surprise, he encounters a completely different side of Kanade—responsible, hardworking, and mature—far from the lazy person he knows at the share house. As the night winds down, Kanade serves Ryota a drink. But after some time, a tipsy Ryota finds himself getting closer and closer to her.

Episodes.Title: We can’t do this in a movie theater...
Episodes.Description: Ryota and Kanade’s passionate connection continues to deepen, and it doesn't go unnoticed, even by Momoka. Sensing the growing tension between them, Momoka decides to invite Ryota to the movie theater to find out how he truly feels. However, Momoka ends up clinging to Ryota in fear of the scary movie. Overcome by the sight of her vulnerability, Ryota can’t help but give in to the moment.

Episodes.Title: One minute... There's no way I can stop...
Episodes.Description: Ryota overhears Momoka and Kanade talking in secret. Have they discovered that he's slept with both of them? But as if to chase away his worries, the girls suggest Ryota spend time together in the living room, with a very specific idea in mind. “Tonight, we'll fulfill one of your requests.” Ryota finds himself faced with a big decision... “One minute... There's no way I can stop...”

Entries.Title: Witch Watch
Entries.Description: A diligent teen winds up living with his spunky childhood friend, a trainee witch, to protect her from a dire prophecy. But can they survive high school?

Episodes.Title: Witch's Return
Episodes.Description: Morihito Otogi is a teenager with ogre strength. His childhood friend, Nico, is coming home after completing her witch training! Following an old pact, they begin living together. Can Morihito protect the clumsy Nico from a dire prophecy?

Episodes.Title: A Giant Rookie / Let's Go to a Diner / The Flying Classroom
Episodes.Description: On the first day of school, Morihito urges Nico to hide the fact that she's a witch, but she tries using magic to secretly help him out in class.

Episodes.Title: Fresh Transparent Fashions for Spring / Witch's Delivery Service / Lost Dogs and the Patter of Rain
Episodes.Description: Nico's mother sends Morihito a letter containing a worrying prophecy. Unable to decipher the meaning, Morihito spends the rest of the day on his toes.

Episodes.Title: Kanshi Kazamatsuri, the Tengu
Episodes.Description: Kanshi explains that Nico's mother sent him to protect her. He and Morihito clash, but he takes a moment to warn him of an enemy within the school.

Episodes.Description: Nico and Kanshi start an online video channel, but Morihito is annoyed by their lack of originality and asks their hipster classmate Magami for help.

Episodes.Title: Kanshi’s Part-Time Job Diaries ~The Superhero Show~ / Kanshi’s Part-Time Job Diaries ~The Side Job~

Episodes.Description: Morihito and the others decide to get rid of any crescent-shaped objects to minimize the risk of Keigo transforming into a werewolf in the house.

Entries.Title: Unexpectedly Naughty Fukami
Entries.Description: "Why is a perfect specimen of a man like me getting this turned on by a guy like that?!" Thus begins the obstinate relationship of a playboy narcissist and a deceivingly frumpily-dressed, hot bodied otaku!

Episodes.Title: A guy to suit Mr.Perfect
Episodes.Description: Kaji, the ace of the sales department, has a secret—he's gay. But dating apps have been a bust, and finding his ideal match seems impossible. Then, one day, he's sent on an overnight business trip with Fukami, a quiet, unassuming guy from the engineering team. At first, Kaji isn't impressed. But when he catches a glimpse of Fukami fresh out of the shower, he realizes—this guy is exactly his type! As they talk, they discover they have more in common than expected—including that they both like men. Could this be the start of something more?!

Episodes.Title: What's Your Game, Zero?!
Episodes.Description: After returning from the business trip, Fukami keeps ignoring Kaji. No one on the dating apps looks a good as Fukami, though! Then, one evening, the two wind up alone together at the office. Fukami tries to leave as if nothing happened, leaving Kaji to say some pretty unexpected things to secure a second date.

Episodes.Title: Fukami and... a Girl?!
Episodes.Description: Kaji consoles a coworker who discovers he'd been dating a married man, and then happens to spot Fukami out with a lady as well, shopping for a ring! The stunned Kaji decides to ask the people at IT if Fukami has a fiancee, only to learn Fukami has been out for the last three days. A concerned Kaji heads to Fukami's house...

Episodes.Title: Say My Name
Episodes.Description: Kaji gets back the smartphone he left at Fukami's place—with Fukami's contact details snuck inside the case! Wanting to see if his feelings are the real deal, Kaji sets a date with Fukami for drinks. On the day of, however, Kaji is caught up by how cute Fukumi is, and things take them back to Kaji's place...

Episodes.Title: I Won't Go Easy On You!
Episodes.Description: Kaji is shocked to see Fukami's new haicut. But Kaji isn't the only one in the office to notice what Fukami has to offer. In a mere three days, he'd gone from a zero to a total ladies' man. Kaji is both annoyed and compelled by Fukami's obliviousness at his own appeal. Seizing the initiative, he ties up Fukami with his necktie...!

Episodes.Title: Sorry, I've Got a Cold
Episodes.Description: After walking home in the pouring rain after being pushed away by Fukami, Kaji has caught a cold. He falls asleep regretting how he told Fukami "We should stop seeing each other for a while." Awakening to the sound of someone calling his name, he sees a worried Fukami peering back at him. Caught up in the shock, Kaji graps Fukamiu close for a kiss...

Episodes.Title: I Couldn't Help But Be Attracted
Episodes.Description: Kaji thought he didn't need love in his life, but meeting Fukami changed that, and so he refuses to just give in. After a simple honest mistake, Kaji's coworker tells him he's just fine without being perfect. Kaji wonders how those words might strike Fukami, and begins to reminisce about their times together...

Episodes.Title: Is It So Bad if I Fall in Love?
Episodes.Description: Kaji goes to see Fukami at the hospital only to be asked what relation he has to the patient. Tears begin to come as he searches for an answer. Realizing how important Fukami truly is to him, the man himself appears right behind him! The two proceed to clear up their miscommunication, and make progress toward to putting aside ill will...

Entries.Title: The Water Magician
Entries.Description: Reincarnation had Ryo dreaming of peace, but instead he lands into a monster-infested wilderness. With water magic and eternal youth, he survives countless wicked concoctions for 20 years, becoming one of the most powerful magicians ever. Ryo’s fate shifts when he meets Abel, a genius knight, thrusting him into magical society’s spotlight. Thus, the Water Magician’s wild adventure begins!

Episodes.Title: The Slow, But Dangerous, Life
Episodes.Description: After dying, Ryo Mihara finds himself reincarnated in a fantasy world with the ability to cast water magic.

Episodes.Title: Abel the Castaway
Episodes.Description: Ryo encounters a castaway who requests his help.

Episodes.Title: The Town of Lune
Episodes.Description: Abel is welcomed back in the town of Lune and Ryo gets acquainted with civilization.

Entries.Title: New Saga
Entries.Description: After a brutal war, magic swordsman Kyle defeats the Demon King but is left dying. A crimson crystal sends him four years into the past to his once-destroyed hometown where he finds his lost loved ones alive. Armed with future knowledge, Kyle vows to prevent the coming tragedy and rewrite fate.

Episodes.Title: I'll Change My Fate
Episodes.Description: Kyle is sent back in time after his fateful fight with the demon king and swears to save the world this time.

Episodes.Title: The Hero's Conditions
Episodes.Description: Kyle sets about making preparations for his heroic journey and the fight to come.

Episodes.Title: Application of the Contract
Episodes.Description: Kyle reunites with some old companions in new ways before making his first major play to change the future.

Episodes.Title: The Perfect Start to a Heroic Tale
Episodes.Description: To save the ill-fated Princess Milena, Kyle must brave a danger the likes of which he's never faced before.

Episodes.Title: Reunion at Dawn
Episodes.Description: Old friends become enemies as Kyle comes up with a plan to get Princess Milena to safety.

Episodes.Title: Brothers in Arms
Episodes.Description: Kyle's party is celebrated for rescuing the princess, but they're given no time to rest on their laurels.
